'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Nigerien crisis]]
**The [[West African]] bloc [[ECOWAS]] announces an emergency summit after [[Niger]]'s government rejected an ultimatum to restore the previous president. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/11/world/americas-emea/west-african-bloc-gathers-for-niger-talks/1904855 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] announces the dismissal of all heads of regional military recruitment centres due to corruption. [https://nos.nl/liveblog/2485729-sluiting-van-russische-luchtruim-om-drones-dode-na-raketaanval-zaporizja (NOS)] [https://www.cnn.com/2023/08/11/europe/zelensky-military-corrruption-scandal-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Russia]] temporarily closes its [[airspace]] above [[Moscow]] due to detection of [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]]. A drone is later shot down. [https://nos.nl/liveblog/2485729-sluiting-van-russische-luchtruim-om-drones-dode-na-raketaanval-zaporizja (NOS)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 global energy crisis]]
**The [[International Energy Agency]] increases its 2023 forecast for [[List of countries by oil consumption|global oil demand]] to a potential all-time annual high of 102.2 million [[Barrel (unit)|barrels]] per day. [https://www.trtworld.com/business/iea-increases-2023-global-oil-demand-projection-approaching-all-time-high-14429268 (AFP via TRT World)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 heat waves]]
**[[2023 European heat waves]]
***[[Valencia]], [[Spain]], sets a new temperature record of {{convert|46.8|C|F}} recorded at the [[Valencia Airport]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/12/world/americas-emea/spains-valencia-shatters-heat-record/1905036 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
**[[2023 Western North America heat wave]]
***[[Governor of Arizona|Governor]] [[Katie Hobbs]] declares a state of emergency in [[Arizona]] amidst the heat waves in the state. [https://www.axios.com/local/phoenix/2023/08/11/arizona-governor-extreme-heat-declaration-emergency (Axios)]
*[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
**Authorities in [[Hawaii]], [[United States]], call the [[Lahaina, Hawaii|Lahaina]] fire the "worst natural disaster in the state's history", as the death toll increases to 80 people, and 11,000 homes and businesses continue to be without electricity. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/maui-wildfire-death-toll-rises-55-search-victims-gears-up-2023-08-11/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Maria Lanakila Catholic Church]] is reportedly still standing despite the wildfires. The [[Banyan tree in Lahaina|banyan tree]] is also standing, but is damaged by the wildfire and it is unknown if it will survive. [https://www.app.com/story/news/nation/2023/08/11/maria-lanakila-church-survive-lahaina/70578213007/ (''Asbury Park Press'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/08/10/us/lahaina-banyan-tree.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] orders the provision of [[Administration of federal assistance in the United States|federal aid]] to supplement state and local recovery efforts. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/12/world/americas-emea/biden-orders-release-of-federal-aid-for-hawaii/1905037 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*Twenty-one people are killed and six others are missing after a [[mudflow]] caused by heavy rains occurs near [[Xi'an]], [[Shaanxi]], [[China]]. Thousands of people have been evacuated. [https://apnews.com/article/china-storms-mudslide-100e4bb766de36c1b12bcf5627e7adfd (AP)]
*Seven people are killed when a [[mosque]] collapses in [[Zaria]], [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/seven-worshippers-killed-northern-nigeria-mosque-collapse-2023-08-11/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and approximately 40,000 are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] due to floods and [[landslide]]s from [[monsoon]] rains in [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/world/2023/08/12/five-dead-40000-evacuated-as-monsoon-floods-hit-myanmar.html (AFP via ''The Jakarta Post'')]
*A [[freight train]] [[Derailment|derails]] in the [[Gotthard Base Tunnel]] in [[Switzerland]], causing the tunnel to be closed for at least six days. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2486260-week-geen-treinverkeer-gotthardtunnel-door-ontspoorde-vrachttrein (NOS)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The United States [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|CDC]] reports that the country recorded its highest number of [[suicide]]s in 2022, with 49,449 people taking their own lives.  [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/11/us-records-highest-number-of-suicides-in-2022 (Al Jazeera)]
*Nearly 14,000 residents of [[Lublin]], [[Poland]], are ordered to evacuate, after an [[unexploded bomb]] was found at the site of a pre-[[World War II]] factory yesterday. [https://tvpworld.com/71938436/14000-people-to-be-evacuated-following-unexploded-bomb-found-in-eastern-poland (TVP World)]
*Due to a long-term structural damage at [[FSO Safer]], a [[Floating production storage and offloading|floating oil storage and offloading]] vessel moored near [[Al Hudaydah]], [[Yemen]], 1.1 million barrels of oil are transferred by [[Smit International]] to another ship to prevent a potential environmental disaster. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2486292-miljoenen-liters-olie-overgepompt-in-jemen-milieuramp-voorkomen (NOS)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Bankruptcy of FTX]]
**[[United States federal judge|American judge]] [[Lewis A. Kaplan]] revokes [[FTX]] co-founder [[Sam Bankman-Fried]]'s [[Bail in the United States|bail]], citing reasonable cause to believe that Bankman-Fried attempted [[witness tampering]] while on bail. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2023/aug/11/sam-bankman-fried-bail-revoked-jail-ftx (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Weiss special counsel investigation]]
**[[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[Merrick Garland]] announces the appointment of [[Delaware]] attorney [[David C. Weiss|David Weiss]] as [[special counsel]] for the investigations into the financial dealings of presidential son [[Hunter Biden]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/08/11/politics/hunter-biden-special-counsel-appointment-merrick-garland/index.html (CNN)]
*A man kills three people, including his ex-wife, and wounds three more, before killing himself, during a [[Spree killer|spree shooting]] in [[Gradačac]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bosnia-killing-instagram-police-murder-15bcfdff24bf6257aefcc360d628b8a4 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Prime Minister of India|Indian Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]]'s [[Second Modi ministry|ministry]] survives a [[motion of no confidence]] in the [[Lok Sabha]] over their response to the [[2023 Manipur violence|ethnic violence]] in the state of [[Manipur]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230810-india-pm-modi-s-government-defeats-no-confidence-motion (AFP via France 24)]
*[[President of South Africa|South African President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] [[pardon]]s his predecessor [[Jacob Zuma]], who was [[convicted]] last year for refusing to testify in [[Jacob Zuma corruption charges|his corruption trial]], alongside other non-violent offenders as part of an attempt to reduce overcrowding in the country's prisons. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/11/south-africas-ramaphosa-pardons-predecessor-zuma-other-offenders (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Roscosmos|Russia]] launches the [[Luna 25]] [[Lunar lander|lunar lander]] at the [[Vostochny Cosmodrome]], which will touch down near the [[Moon]]'s [[lunar south pole|south pole]]. The mission will investigate the composition of the moon's polar [[Lunar soil|soil]] as well as the plasma and dust contained in the [[Atmosphere of the Moon|lunar exosphere]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2023/08/10/world/russia-luna-25-launch-scn/index.html (CNN)]
